findings.summary: Promotion-tail review validation previously trusted verdict without complete blocker semantics.
findings.failure_scenario: An approved report retains an open, malformed, critical accepted-risk, required-fix, or explicitly blocking record.
findings.impact: A promotion blocker could be inherited or a valid resolved finding could be rejected.
findings.minimum_fix: Validate the canonical severity/status matrix, required fixes, and approval effect fail closed.

findings.summary: Work-proof marker task identities were not uniformly bound to the selected task.
findings.failure_scenario: A marker carries the candidate SHA but names another task at the top level or in an authorized binding.
findings.impact: Cross-task evidence could be inherited by path alone.
findings.minimum_fix: Require every present marker task identity and authorized binding to equal the selected task.

findings.summary: Canonical acceptance-ledger and task-state schemas were missing from the protected risk inventory.
findings.failure_scenario: A future low- or medium-risk task names either schema as an exact allowed path.
findings.impact: Acceptance or persistence semantics could change without high-risk gates.
findings.minimum_fix: Add both exact schema paths to the protected inventory and table-driven tests.

residual_risks: The protected exact-path inventory must be updated when new authority or security-control surfaces are introduced.

state_impact: Only M0-14 canonical acceptance is rebound after review.
source_of_truth_changes: Review blocker semantics, marker task binding, and two protected schema paths are made fail-closed.
feedback_plan: Protected CI and latest-head remote review validate the new DeliveryHead.
blast_radius: Task planning and promotion evidence only; no product packages.
rollback_or_deletion_test: Focused adversarial tests reject each removed or malformed binding and policy signal.
systems_questions.system_model_summary: One reviewed repair ProductCandidate replaces the prior accepted candidate; only its canonical promotion evidence may follow.
